description: Engine setup of map1_s02 (School Otherworld - 1F and courtyard), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type SU, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Stalker, GreyChild, Mumbler and Creeper). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: water (the running water stream and its ribbon). A mod changes it with its own maps/map1_s02/overlay.json.
